name: @victframework/ui-svelte
description: The permanent Svelte renderer for Vict Application Plans: the canonical ApplicationRenderer (mount/update/unmount machinery, generic VitApp host, recursive surface traversal, table/form/overlay adapters, route + structural validation, presentation normalization, canonical form-value conversion) plus the shared presentation components and packaged styles. Framework-neutral packages never depend on Svelte — Svelte lives only in this renderer boundary.
